Here's the completion summary:

## Goal
Build a single, self-contained `index.html` implementing a pixel-art painting tool with editable canvas size, color palette with swatches and custom color input, brush/eraser tools, undo/redo, clear canvas, PNG export, mouse/touch support — verified against 21 tests via the proof harness.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] All 21/21 tests pass (`npm test` from `strategies/proof/qwen/03_pixel_painter/`)
- [x] App boots without runtime errors (T1)
- [x] Canvas defaults to 16x16 (T2)
- [x] Palette renders 18 swatches + custom color input (T3)
- [x] All toolbar buttons present (T4)
- [x] Apply size changes canvas dimensions (T5)
- [x] Clicking palette swatch changes paint color with active state (T6)
- [x] Single pixel placement via click (T7)
- [x] Drag paints a connected line via Bresenham interpolation (T8)
- [x] Eraser clears pixel back to transparent `[0,0,0,0]` (T9)
- [x] Clear button resets canvas (T10)
- [x] Undo restores prior state (T11)
- [x] Redo re-applies undone change (T12)
- [x] Touch events work on canvas (T13,T14)
- [x] Export triggers dataURL download (T15)
- [x] Keyboard shortcuts: B/brush, E/eraser, Ctrl+Z/undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z/redo (T16-T19)
- [x] Only one swatch active at a time (T20)
- [x] Custom color input changes paint color (T21)

### Key fixes applied during proof mode:
1. **Undo/Redo transparent state** — Changed init to use `clearRect()` instead of `fillRect('#000')` so the initial state is transparent pixels `[0,0,0,0]`, matching test expectations for undo/redo restoring to transparent.
2. **Custom color input handler** — Added `input` event listener on `#custom-color-input` to update `currentColor`.
3. **Bresenham line interpolation** — Implemented `drawLine()` function so drag painting produces connected lines (not just start/end points).
